notes: ForeverCultFund is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its no-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 FOREVER to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. Transfers have no tax or burn. There are no external mint, burn, administrative or upgrade functions. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
